haar_orientation_counterexample.runtime_sigma_field: trivial, hence g is independent of it
haar_orientation_counterexample.conclusion: Independence of g from runtime features alone is insufficient when f may depend on g.
haar_orientation_counterexample.repair: Require Law(g | f, runtime information)=Haar, e.g. g independent of sigma(f) joined with the runtime sigma-field.

replication_counterexample.errors: e_i=b deterministically; degenerate random variables are mutually independent
replication_counterexample.conclusion: Independent errors need not have zero cross-inner-product. The score-neutral statement requires mean-zero or pairwise uncorrelated errors.

observability_ratio_edge.repair: Assume positive oracle value or define a convention separately.
